source.note: OpenUtau is Avalonia (XAML) based. Themes are two static ResourceDictionaries (Dark/Light) plus user YAML themes. Styles are theme-independent and reference DynamicResource palette keys.

applyCustomTheme.value: CustomTheme.ApplyTheme copies every ThemeYaml color field into Application.Resources

customThemeDefaults.note: OpenUtau/Colors/CustomTheme.axaml is the built-in default custom theme; it is a copy of LightTheme except it has NO WarningColor key. The ThemeYaml defaults in CustomTheme.axaml.cs match it.

icons.renderingApproach: Vector: every UI icon is an inline Avalonia <Path Data="..."> geometry (SVG path mini-language). There are no per-icon .svg/.png files in the source tree; only the app icon / logos exist as image assets.

bitmapAndLogoAssets.usage: Window Icon (referenced by every Window via Icon="/Assets/open-utau.ico")

icons: gear/settings, snap, lock, expression toggles, zoom, etc. (filled/stroked classes)

inlineIconLocations.note: Listed via Style Selector ListBoxItem.<name>Tool /template/ Path#PART_ToolIcon; each geometry is an inline Data= string.
